newsitem.title: UK: UK barley futures close steady on export demand.
newsitem.headline: UK barley futures close steady on export demand.

text.p: UK barley futures closed around 0.50 to 0.60 stg up on Wednesday mainly on increased export demand.
Earlier barley prices had been as much as one stg up but prices dipped towards the close on profit-taking.
"There are reports of a number of vessels loading barley for export and people feel that some of the Saudi business may come our way," said a trader.

Saudi Arabia was seeking barley at a tender which opened on September 20 and although the result has yet to be confirmed reports suggest it has bought 1.4 millions tonnes of barley for import from October to December.
At the close barley futures were 0.60 to 0.50 stg up after trading 209 lots.
Traders said the wheat market appears to have lost its way for now with prices tending to drift lower and at the close values were 0.75 to 0.25 stg down on a turnover of 328 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract was again neglected.

Traders reported little activity on the UK delivered grain market while the fob coaster sector attracted business for feed wheat at 109.50 stg a tonne for Nov and 109 stg for Dec feed barley both in vessels up to 2,400 tonnes fob east coast ports.
